howToPlay: Use your twin lasers to bounce shots off walls and harass enemies from a distance. Deploy your supply drop to buff teammates and grant them increased health and damage. Utilize your sandbags or barrage gadget to control the field and survive engagements.
gears: Use SPEED to navigate the map quickly, HEALTH to recover faster, DAMAGE to boost offensive output, or SHIELD to increase overall survivability.
trait: This support brawler suits players who enjoy tactical positioning and empowering their teammates to dominate the battlefield.
